# llm_cache table presence

The database schema must include a table named "llm_cache": the migration's upgrade creates the "llm_cache" table (if missing) and the downgrade drops the "llm_cache" table.

Implement ADR-008 by ensuring a persistent, content-addressed cache for LLM-related data exists in the database and can be removed when rolling back the migration.
